summary: PO FASE 1 (brand cleanup + SEO/META v1) + FASE 2 (user self-registration + role approval v1) end-to-end verification. BACKEND: reused/executed /app/backend/tests/test_self_registration_v1.py — 7/7 passed. Added new /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_brand_seo_regression.py — 7 passed / 1 skipped (landing/public endpoint returned 404 on all probed paths; not asserted). Direct API smoke also confirmed: SUSPEND→login 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED, REACTIVATE→login 200, REJECT→login 403 ACCOUNT_NOT_APPROVED with NO 'motivo interno' leak in either login response or GET /api/auth/registration/{id}; CUSTOMER role approval links to existing customer_id (customer-matches decision NO_MATCH when email/phone differ — still allowed with explicit customer_id), portal login 200, backoffice login 401; privilege-escalation payload (role='super_admin', tenant_id='other', permissions=['*'], is_superadmin=true) is IGNORED — stored requested_role='commerciale', approved_tenant_id=null, is_superadmin absent; requested_role='super_admin' → 400 ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED; duplicate email → 409 ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS; approve on unverified request → 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION. FRONTEND (Playwright, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): SEO gates ALL green — /landing document.title='Software Gestionale per Serramentisti | Panorama Pilot', meta robots='index, follow', canonical/og:title/og:image/twitter:card/JSON-LD present, html lang='it', brand 'Panorama Pilot' in DOM, no 'Emergent' text; /login title 'Accedi | Panorama Pilot' robots 'noindex, nofollow' with auth-tab-login + auth-tab-register visible; /register title 'Registrati | Panorama Pilot' robots noindex; /dashboard robots 'noindex, nofollow'; /customer-portal title 'Area Clienti | Panorama Pilot' robots noindex. Assets: GET /sitemap.xml → 200 with only /landing (no /login, /register, /dashboard, /customer-portal, /registration-status, /registration-requests); GET /manifest.json → name='Panorama Pilot'; GET /og-image.png → 200. Full self-registration UI flow verified end-to-end: /register submit → register-success + register-request-id; register-requested-role-select native <select> options = [cliente, commerciale, tecnico_rilievo, produzione, magazzino, posatore, amministrazione, viewer] — NO super_admin/admin_azienda; /verify-email?token=<debug_verification_token> → verify-success; /registration-status shows 'attesa di approvazione'; login with pending account → login-error 'Il tuo account è in attesa di approvazione' + login-pending-status-link. Superadmin flow: admin login → nav lands on /registration-requests (registration-requests-page rendered), approve-btn-{id} opens approve-dialog with approve-tenant-select (Infissi Express Test + PanoramaPilot) and approve-role-select excluding super_admin/admin_azienda; approving commerciale on tenant Infissi Express Test → toast 'Richiesta approvata', request status APPROVED; the admin sidebar shows tenant brand 'INFISSI EXPRESS / CLOUD ERP' (tenant branding preserved). RBAC of the newly approved commerciale: /auth/login 200 (user.tenant_id=5e35…, is_superadmin=false); GET /api/registration-requests → 403; GET /api/quotes → 200; /auth/me permissions include financials.view (as PO noted, acceptable per RBAC), NO '*' and NO users.manage. Responsive /register: 1280×720, 1366×768 and 390×844 all pass — REGISTRATI button in viewport after scroll_into_view, no horizontal overflow. Regression: admin login still works, PDF quote preview response filename carries 'infissi_express_...' brand token and NO 'Emergent' leak. All 7 self-reg test records + orphan users/customer_portal_users deleted post-run (reg cleanup: 5/1/1).

minor.issue: 404 — no landing config endpoint reachable at /landing/public, /landing/config, /public/landing or /branding/public. If a public landing config with product_name is a PO deliverable, expose one; else this row can be ignored. Currently the brand 'Panorama Pilot' is only surfaced via SPA SEO helmet + /manifest.json + /og-image.png (all confirmed).

action_items: OPTIONAL: expose GET /api/landing/public (or equivalent) that returns product_name='Panorama Pilot' for parity with the PO regression check. Non-blocking — brand is already exposed via /manifest.json and Helmet on /landing.

OBSERVATIONAL: on the initial DOM render at /dashboard the nav-registration-requests testid is briefly absent (locator.count()==0) but Playwright's auto-wait resolves in <1s and the click succeeds — timing only, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /api/auth/register hardens against privilege-escalation payloads (role/tenant_id/permissions/is_superadmin ignored, stored requested_role wins) — confirmed by direct fuzzing.

GOOD: dual-auth surface correctly enforced — customer_portal_users only used when approve.effective_role='cliente' with a linked customer_id; backoffice login 401 for portal-only accounts and vice-versa.
GOOD: reject internal reason never leaks in login 403 body nor in GET /api/auth/registration/{id} public status.

GOOD: SEO helmet strategy centralised in src/seo — every route sets the right robots directive (index only on /landing; noindex on /login, /register, /dashboard, /customer-portal). Absolute-URL canonical uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly.

GOOD: RegisterPage uses a NATIVE <select> for register-requested-role-select (not shadcn) — deliberate for accessibility on mobile; option list matches whitelist (admin roles excluded server-side too via /api/auth/register/roles).

NIT: RegistrationRequestsPage should ideally show a small explanatory tooltip on approve-role-select stating 'super_admin/admin_azienda must be assigned via user management, not via registration approval' — currently the whitelist is silently applied.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (SEO gates, register E2E, superadmin approval, RBAC negative, reject, customer, responsive — all pass)
